description: Route every inference consumer through the existing inference port and resolve the model from a declarative role/tier mapping against the live provider registry, so adding a model is config (hex config inference add + one mapping line), never code. Implements ADR-2605301224. POLICY-NEUTRAL: this refactor does NOT decide which model the hot path uses (local Ollama vs Tenstorrent) — that stays a declarative policy value, governed separately.
notes: Out of scope: the hot-path model policy (ADR-2026-05-22-1710 reframe). The resolver must keep a local-Ollama fallback wired for cloud outage/credit exhaustion. Roll out the SOP reroute behind a flag.
